FROM products

guided.sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.stock_quantity,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= date('2005-07-01') AND o.status = 'completed' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) as units_sold_last_60d
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE p.stock_quantity > 0
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.stock_quantity
HAVING units_sold_last_60d < 10
ORDER BY p.stock_quantity DESC
LIMIT 5
guided.resolution: Binds to rule_slow_moving_inventory: Combines high warehouse stock (>20 units) with low sales velocity (<3 units sold in 60d).

       COUNT(o.order_id) as total_orders,

FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.category
HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) >= 5
ORDER BY return_percentage DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.stock_quantity,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= date('2005-07-01') AND o.status = 'completed' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) as units_sold_last_60d
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE p.stock_quantity > 0
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.stock_quantity
HAVING units_sold_last_60d < 10
ORDER BY p.stock_quantity DESC
LIMIT 5
guided.resolution: Verifies trailing 60-day sales window against in-stock levels.
guided.rule_applied: rule_slow_moving_inventory (High Stock and Low Recent Demand)

detailed_results.prompt: Show total discount granted to customers

baseline.sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(o.discount_amount) as total_discounts
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
ORDER BY total_discounts DESC
LIMIT 5
baseline.failure_mode: Sums discount_amount without filtering out cancelled or returned orders.

guided.sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.segment,
       ROUND(SUM(o.discount_amount), 2) as total_discount_granted,
       ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) as net_spent,
       COUNT(o.order_id) as completed_orders
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.segment
ORDER BY total_discount_granted DESC
LIMIT 5
guided.resolution: Sums discounts only on realized, completed transactions.
guided.rule_applied: rule_discount_impact (Promotional Dollars Granted on Completed Orders)
